title: Bootstrap Argo CD from a VPC-internal runner
expected_outcome: A dedicated VPC-internal, ECR-only bootstrap path installs the reviewed private Argo CD chart using immutable private image tags and exposes only ClusterIP services.
constraints: No public endpoint, NAT, Vault init/unseal, secret material, workload Application sync, or release-signing activation.
The bootstrap executor is separate from the Vault release signer and receives only the permissions required for Argo CD installation and status verification.

external_actions: publish and approve a digest-pinned non-secret bootstrap toolchain
create approved VPC-internal bootstrap runner infrastructure
install the approved private Argo CD chart

primary_owner.responsibility: runner security boundary and deployment integration
